🎙 **Guest Primer – Ella Mitchell, Marketing Director for Dr. Repta & Restore Renew Med Spa**  

Hi Ella,  
I’m so excited to have you on **The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge!** Below is a quick primer with background, focus areas, and sample questions to help guide our conversation. Nothing is scripted — the goal is a casual, engaging chat that highlights your expertise and insights in aesthetics and wellness marketing.  

---

📅 **Podcast Recording Details**  
- **Date & Time:** Tuesday, September 17th at 2:00 PM CST  
- **Platform:** [Riverside.fm](https://riverside.fm)  
- **Prep Tips:** Please make sure you’re in a well-lit room with good Wi-Fi and a quality mic or headphones if possible.  

---

👩‍💼 **About Ella**  
Ella Mitchell is the marketing director for **Dr. Remus Repta**, one of the nation’s leading surgeons specializing in **plus-size plastic surgery and advanced body contouring**. She oversees all marketing initiatives for both his surgical practice and **Restore Renew Med Spa** in Scottsdale, AZ.  

From managing content strategy and social media campaigns to Google Ads, email, and live Q&A sessions, Ella has built a marketing engine that bridges brand awareness with true patient acquisition. She understands the unique challenges of marketing in aesthetics — where followers don’t always equal patients — and focuses on high-quality leads, ROI-driven campaigns, and authentic content that builds trust.  

---

💡 **Topics We’ll Explore**  
- Marketing plastic surgery and med spa services in today’s competitive digital landscape  
- The unique niche of plus-size body contouring and how to communicate it to the right audience  
- Balancing social media growth with patient acquisition (quality vs. vanity metrics)  
- Building a brand voice that feels both professional and approachable  
- Challenges and wins in launching and growing Restore Renew Med Spa  
- Trends in patient education, Q&As, and content that actually converts  

---

❓ **Sample Questions**  
1. Can you share a little about your role with Dr. Repta and how you balance marketing for both a surgical practice and a med spa?  
2. Dr. Repta is known for his plus-size body contouring — how do you approach marketing something so specialized?  
3. Social media has become a huge driver in aesthetics, but not all followers equal patients. How do you track ROI and make sure efforts translate into booked procedures?  
4. What’s been the most effective marketing channel for you — Instagram, TikTok, Google Ads, or something else?  
5. You’ve mentioned the importance of live Q&As and patient education. Why do you think those resonate so well with your audience?  
6. What advice would you give to other med spas or practices trying to grow without falling into the “influencer trap”?  
7. How do you see the integration of med spa + surgical services shaping the future of aesthetics?  

---

👗 **Wardrobe Note:** Since this episode will showcase your expertise in a professional yet approachable way, I’d recommend wearing **a bold jewel tone (emerald green, sapphire blue, or plum)**. These shades photograph well on video, convey confidence, and help you stand out against neutral backdrops.  

---  

Would you like me to also add a **section with promotional links** (practice website, socials, etc.) so you can plug them at the end of the show?
